technical_offer: Canadian metering delivery/integration lead candidate; training and support

email.subject: Amherst metering: delivery + ultrasonic OEM scope
email.initial:
Hi Scott,

Amherst’s RFP-26-09 calls for ultrasonic water metering and a phased rollout. Metercor’s Canadian metering work and its stated Badger distribution relationship suggest a practical conversation with Badger Meter about a compliant meter, communications and support bundle.

The Town expects to install most meters. The useful joint scope may be supply, data integration, training and support; lead qualifications and product/territory authorization need checking.

Would you be open to a 20-minute technical scoping discussion? If there is a fit, I’d ask both sides before arranging an introduction with Timothy Wissing. Neither side has committed.

If this is outside your remit, a referral would help. If you would prefer no further emails, please let me know.
followups:
Hi Scott,

Following up on Amherst RFP-26-09 water metering. The first question is whether Badger Meter would add a distinct, necessary work package. For your side, I had in mind: canadian metering delivery/integration lead candidate; training and support.

Is that a useful scope to explore, or should I speak with another owner?

Hi Scott,

A practical agenda for the proposed Badger Meter discussion would be: meter size/approval matrix; endpoint compatibility; network coverage; billing export; warranty; phased acceptance. The output could be a one-page responsibility and evidence matrix before either firm spends time on a bid.

Which interface or qualification would you want to resolve first?

Hi Scott,

For Amherst RFP-26-09 water metering, I would keep the commercial discussion tied to an agreed work package, acceptance criteria and delivery capacity. There is no assumed award, fee split or partner commitment.

Would you be comfortable assessing a possible introduction with Timothy Wissing at Badger Meter, once the access and scope questions are resolved?

Hi Scott,

I’ll close this proposed Badger Meter introduction for now. If a technical discussion would be useful, let me know the right owner and I can coordinate once both sides agree. If this tender is not a fit, a brief “not this one” is enough.

If you prefer no further emails, please let me know.
